Emma — quick note as we close the month. We're updating SFDC and finalizing the finance forecast; can you confirm the expected PO submit date and procurement lead time for the StellarHealth pilot? A short confirmation will let us lock the close date in the forecast.

If possible, please attach any PO term doc or procurement checklist (even a one-pager). If it helps, see the two asks below: 

- Confirm whether you expect PO signed by 2027-07-12 or if procurement needs more time.
- Share the preferred billing contact and any required dev/IT approvals (names/emails).

I've attached a one-page forecast summary for our internal tracker (forecast-summary.xlsx). Once we have confirmation, we'll:
1) Update SFDC close date and stage to Closed-Commit (internal)
2) Capture the evidence snapshot in the deal record

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Kimberly Park
